verified_behaviors: Each of three department contacts has three actual source records in native IM: original request, revised request and supplemental request. All nine records show matching request IDs, dates, product SKUs, specifications and quantities.
Revised-request links open the corresponding Shop request directly. The user can return to all nine requests, filter by department, inspect the product catalog and consult the department directory.
The normal native IM send control persists discussion in the same isolated workspace; it does not alter procurement source records or satisfy delivery checks.

All A/B/C conditions were completed by native UI controls through three department orders, actual line quantities and rule-formatted notes. Saved orders survive reload. Extra draft deletion remains available.

API tests verify message recipient and payload validation, persistence, idempotency and reset; existing procurement API tests verify final orders, invalid addresses, quantities, notes, unsaved edits and duplicate orders.
